children: Cargojet is revamping its internal operations to better and more efficiently use its fleet. CIBC's Kevin Chiang says the company is "acutely focusing on managing cost and re-emphasized its One Fleet Strategy"--Cargojet's plan to integrate domestic, ACMI and charter operations into a single network. One example is a new Liege route thatreduces "empty backhaul" and improves round-trip economics. "CJT's One Fleet strategy accentuates that the company operates one network and not three separate business segments," Chiang says, allowing the company to increase fleet utilization while "thoughtfully adding new routes that generate returns above its hurdle rate."(adriano.marchese@wsj.com)
